mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of converting a garage into an ADU versus building a new detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing garage into an ADU often offers several advantages over building a new detached unit. It's generally more cost-effective because the existing foundation, walls, and roof structure are already in place, reducing material and labor costs. The construction timeline can also be shorter. Additionally, garage conversions often face fewer zoning restrictions compared to new detached builds. However, a new detached ADU might offer more design flexibility and privacy. We can discuss which option best suits your property and goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions are often more cost-effective and faster than new detached ADUs due to using existing structures, but detached units offer more design freedom.
